rationale: Builds on the current 9x512 reverse-tail recurrent best. The existing iteration-normalized ramp never reaches its ramp window in a 600s Mac-mini run, so the first recurrent tail block trains mostly at 0.35 gain while final evaluation uses full gain. This wrapper applies a surgical runtime patch that adds sparse compile-stable full-gain pulses from steps 64-480, exposing the tail to the exact eval profile without changing data paths, validation cadence, export budget, or final int8+zlib scoring.
title: Pulsed Full-Gain Reverse-Tail Curriculum
